messages:
marta: Quick q — are we comfortable adding a 'flavor' discriminator to rollout metadata (eg `flavor: fp16|int8|sparse`) so routing can prefer compatible variants?
kevin: I think so. It would simplify runtime matching instead of enumerating model hashes. But need to be clear about compatibility semantics.
olivia: +1 on flavor field. Also: should rollout manifest allow a 'min_compat' semantics vs strict equality? Some infra needs backwards-compatible weights.
raj: Agree on min_compat, but we should avoid magic. Proposal: two fields: `compatible_with: [semver|hash-range|flavor]` and `strict_pin: true|false`. If strict_pin=true then only exact model_id accepted.
sam: lean towards explicitness: `allow_variants: true/false` and `variant_selector: flavor_priority_list` — simpler for the config UI and console.
marta: also need lifecycle metadata: expiry vs soft-expiry. Example: if rollout has `soft_expiry: 2026-07-01` then clients can probe for replacements but runtime continues to serve with warning. Hard expiry evicts.
kevin: +1. soft_expiry helps staged deprecations. We should also include `grace_window_seconds` so Dedicated customers can opt-in to longer drains.
olivia: compatibility with existing pinning: can we map old `pin_id` -> new manifest? Migration plan: API returns both legacy_pin and rollout_manifest until cutoff.
raj: Ops ask: telemetry keys. Add `rollout_id` and `origin` (user/auto/console) fields so we can trace which rollouts caused evictions.
sam: small UX note: when flavor=quantized/int8, we need explicit `quant_profile` pointer so serving knows which kernel path to pick. Example manifest snippet:```json
{
  "rollout_id": "ro_20260701_42",
  "model_id": "gptx-13b-v2",
  "flavor": "int8",
  "quant_profile": "qv2-low-latency",
  "allow_variants": true,
  "soft_expiry": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z",
  "grace_window_seconds": 86400
}
```
marta: good. Edge-case: tenant overrides. We want tenant-scoped overrides but default to global. Suggest `overrides: [{tenant: "tenant-a", flavor: "fp16"}]`. Must ensure private deployments can't be overridden by hosted policies.
kevin: security check: tenant overrides must be scoped by org_id and require admin audit log. Add `approval_required: true|false` and `approval_auditor` metadata.
olivia: another tradeoff: keeping both flavor and model_hash list increases redundancy. But flavor is user-friendly. We'll accept duplication and let validation ensure flavor matches hashes.
raj: runtime note: if flavor mismatch at routing time, fallback order should be: exact model_id -> compatible flavor variant -> fallback model pool per tenant policy. Document it in the rollout docs.
sam: last: we should version the rollout manifest schema itself: `schema_version: "2026-07-rc1"`. That avoids parsing ambiguity later.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: rollout-metadata-schema v0.3 -> staging (tests: schema validation, migration shim). :rocket:
marta: OK next steps: PR with schema draft + migration shim that maps legacy pins to new fields. I'll open a short RFC with examples and a few migration scripts. Anyone want to pair on the shim?
kevin: I can take the shim tests. olivia can review the RFC. raj will add telemetry hooks. Sam will prototype the console UI mapping.
marta: thanks all. I'll post RFC link in this thread when ready. :+1:
